correctness.rationale: For arbitrary finite field F_q (including characteristic 2) any invertible T is torsion and N nilpotent iff N=[[a,b],[c,-a]] with a²+bc=0. The nilpotent cone has q² points on q+1 projective rays [-uv:u²:-v²]. Expanding det(A-N) = det A +(alpha-delta)a+gamma b+beta c, and the linear functional vanishes on a ray precisely for an F_q eigenline of A. When det A nonzero each nonzero-functional ray contributes one bad multiple: d=q²-q-1+e. When det A zero, bad points are zero plus q-1 points from each of e zero-functional rays: d=q²-1-(q-1)e. Classification of nonzero singular matrices and invertible split types gives min (q-1)² and source equality cases (for q=2 an invertible nonsplit class also ties). Source finite checker enumerates all matrices q=2,3,5,7; this finite check corroborates but all prime powers follow from ray proof.

value.rationale: A natural count refining recently studied t-fine decomposability for the smallest full matrix algebra. The formula classifies all nonzero matrices and sharp multiplicity extremizers via intrinsic eigenline geometry, not a contrived small finite slice.
